info.description: Hexagonal blog platform REST API. Envelope responses use { ok, code, data, meta, error }.
info.title: Blog API

get.description: Comments in any status across posts. Defaults to the moderation queue (pending and flagged), oldest first.

parameters.description: comma-separated statuses: pending, approved, flagged, spam, rejected, deleted
parameters.name: status

post.description: Applies one action to up to 500 comments in a single transaction: all change or none do. Unknown ids return 404 and disallowed transitions 409, both listing the offending ids in error.details.ids.

get.description: Any status, with author identity, flags, and the moderation log with before/after snapshots.

delete.description: Removes the comment row. A comment with replies is scrubbed instead (content and author erased, kept as a deleted placeholder) so its replies survive; outcome reports which happened. The action is recorded in the moderation log.

post.description: approve, reject, or spam a comment, or restore a deleted one. Returns 409 when the action is not allowed from the current status.

delete.description: Soft delete: the post leaves public and admin reads and releases its slug. List with trashed=true and restore to undo.

post.description: Hides a draft, scheduled, or published post from public reads; published_at is kept. Publish again to bring it back.
Allowed from draft, scheduled, or archived; sets published_at to now. Returns 409 post.invalid_transition for a post that is already published.
Brings a soft-deleted post back as a draft. If a live post took its slug meanwhile, the slug gets the lowest free numeric suffix (-2, -3, …).
Returns a published or scheduled post to draft and clears published_at.

get.summary: Get a comment with its first replies

delete.description: Soft delete: the comment stays in the thread as a placeholder without content or author.

patch.description: Authors may edit their own comment within the edit window after posting.

post.description: Repeat flags from the same user (or guest IP and user agent) are accepted but counted once.

post.summary: Toggle my upvote on a comment

post.description: Multipart field "file". JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF identified by content (not the declared type), at most 8192x8192.

get.description: All of the caller's comments except deleted ones, newest first, including pending and rejected.

post.description: Consumes the token sent to the new address, marks it verified, and revokes every session.
Verifies the password and sends a confirmation token to the new address; the current address gets a notice.

patch.description: Allowlisted fields only; omitted keys are kept, null clears, unknown keys are rejected.

get.description: Top-level comments by default; pass parent_id to list the direct replies of a comment.

post.description: Signed-in users comment as themselves. Guests send author_name and author_email when guest comments are enabled; guest comments await moderation.

get.description: Looked up by username or user UUID. Private profiles are 404 except for the owner and admins.

author_name.description: Guest commenters only; ignored when a bearer token is sent.

content.description: Plain text or markdown; HTML is not rendered.

honeypot.description: Leave empty. Anti-spam trap for bots; must stay hidden in forms.

notify_author.description: Recorded in the moderation log for author notifications.

category_id.description: Category UUID; null clears the category, omitting the field keeps it.

Bearer.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT access token.
Bearer.name: Authorization
